releaseNotes:
Feature: Search and open older projects beyond the top 10 recent (header More + Telegram pages/search)
Feature: Project setup syncs from remote first when GitHub already has history, with live fetch progress
Fix: Setup no longer overwrites a remote .gitignore with a local bootstrap file
Fix: SSH keepalives every 10s to reduce idle NAT/firewall disconnects
Fix: Clearer terminal message when the SSH session drops
Fix: SSH BatchMode avoids hanging on passphrase/host prompts during setup
